review.notes: Full read-through of all 7 physical PDF pages against the OCR markdown; physical pages 1 and 6 were rendered and visually checked. The Contributions and Acknowledgments two-column layout was flattened with names scattered across the wrong role groups; the block is restored to the printed grouping. The p.1 corresponding-author line was missing. Remaining token deltas are figure-internal axis labels (Figure 3) and hyphenated names that the markdown joins correctly.
